world.title: Nepal rescuers blast hillside in search of hydropower workers as families wait anxiously
world.description: Rescuers have resorted to explosives as they struggle to reach trapped workers, as the flooding death toll reaches 939.

world.title: US singer D4vd's celebrity lawyers withdraw from murder case
world.description: The singer, 21, will be now represented by a public defender in the murder trial of 14-year-old Celeste Rivas Hernandez. He has pleaded not guilty.

world.title: Man arrested after Swiss rave shooting that killed woman
world.description: A 22-year-old Italian woman was killed and several injured at a techno rave in Aarau.

world.title: 'She slipped out of my hand' - children missing after ferry sinks off northern Cyprus
world.description: Ayten and Hayri Bicer's two young children are among 20 missing in an incident that killed eight people.

world.title: US and Iran trade strikes for first time in weeks
world.description: The attack on Larak Island in the Strait of Hormuz - the first known US strike since late July - has killed two people and injured two others.

world.title: US Supreme Court clears way for Trump to keep building White House ballroom
world.description: But Chief Justice John Roberts dissents, writing that "construction is likely unlawful".

world.title: Festival honouring Dolly Parton set for Nashville and London
world.description: Dolly Parton's estate says DollyFest will take the place of a traditional public memorial for the artist, just as she wanted.

world.title: Ex-congressman George Santos banned from betting platform for life
world.description: The prediction market operator Kalshi says Santos made barred trades and misleading comments that influenced prices.

world.title: Messi retires from international football with 'nothing left to give'
world.description: Argentina great Lionel Messi announces his retirement from international football, saying it was a decision that "hurt" but he understands "the time has come".

world.title: John Galliano exhibition at New York Met cancelled after backlash
world.description: The exhibition faced criticism over the British fashion designer's conviction for making antisemitic remarks in 2011.

world.title: Trump pushes Apple to change 'Lake Ontario' to 'Lake America' on its maps
world.description: The request comes after Google made the switch for US-based users over the weekend. MapQuest, another US map provider, said it will not change the name.

world.title: South African airline defends low-altitude aerial stunt over packed stadium
world.description: Airlink says the manoeuvre with two planes in close formation involved careful and precise planning.

world.title: Company offering reward for safe return of truckload of beer
world.description: Police say a thief presented false documentation at a California distribution centre before driving off with the shipment.

world.title: 'Moonies' church leader jailed for two years over bribery offences
world.description: Han Hak-ja, 83, gave South Korea's former first lady two Chanel bags and a diamond necklace, a court found.

world.title: Two dead and more than a dozen missing after 'terrifying' flash flood hits Grand Canyon
world.description: "It was a beautiful day - and then people were screaming," one hiker tells the BBC, as 14 people are missing.

US.title: Whatever happened to the U.S. famine alert system that Trump shut down, then reopened
US.description: The highly regarded FEWS NET network stopped posting data on Afghanistan, Somalia and Yemen -- then says it will start posting again in September. What's the reason for this back-and-forth?

US.title: Kalshi bans former congressman George Santos for life after State of the Union trades
US.description: Kalshi says Santos did not cooperate with its investigation into bets he placed on his own attendance at the State of the Union. The company also fined the disgraced congressman more than $71,000.

US.title: The U.S. sues Amazon again
US.description: Federal regulators and 22 states allege that the tech giant made billions by manipulating how much brands and sellers paid for ads on its platform.

US.title: Paperwork, lines, hours on hold: There's a 'Time Tax' on Americans who need help most

US.title: Lionel Messi says he's retiring from playing internationally for Argentina
US.description: The soccer star is ending 21 years of Argentine national-team duty but will continue to play at club level with Inter Miami in U.S. Major League Soccer.

US.title: Nepal's hesitance to accept foreign help for flood relief comes under scrutiny
US.description: A group of the country's private sector power producers says Nepali authorities lost crucial time in rescuing hundreds of people trapped in hydropower tunnels.

US.title: U.S., Venezuela strike oil deal. And, the staggering hidden toll of U.S. heat deaths
US.description: The U.S. and Venezuela have entered into an oil deal. And, NPR spent two years tracking heat-related deaths and found that people in the U.S. are dying from heat more than the official counts show.

US.title: Russia's jet-powered drones bring empty Kyiv supermarket shelves and rattle Ukrainians
US.description: Russian forces relentlessly battered Kyiv and cities in the region around the Ukrainian capital for a fifth straight day, leaving some supermarket shelves bare after repeated strikes on warehouses.

US.title: Attacks flare between the U.S. and Iran after a monthlong pause
US.description: U.S. threats erupt into attacks in the Strait of Hormuz, and Iran retaliates against U.S. targets in the United Arab Emirates and Jordan in the first exchange of fire since July 29.
